name: 位相コングルエンシー
description: 検出します edges and 特徴 using phase congruency in the 周波数領域. This 照明-invariant method reveals structural differences in AI content.
mechanism: 分析します phase alignment にわたる multiple frequency scales. Phase congruency highlights structural 特徴 invariant to 照明.
parameters: Scales: 4, Orientations: 6, Noise 閾値: 適応型
source: Morrone and Owens (1987), Pattern Recognition Letters
useCase: Detecting structural 異常 in AI生成の images

references.title: Kovesi, P. (2000). Phase Congruency: A Low-Level Image Invariant. Psychological Research.
Morrone, M.C. & Owens, R.A. (1987). Feature Detection from Local Energy. Pattern Recognition Letters.
Kovesi, P. (1999). Image Features from Phase Congruency. Journal of Computer Vision Research.

strengths:
• Contrast-invariant edge and 特徴 検出
• Based on local energy model of 特徴 perception
• 検出します edges regardless of 照明 changes
• Provides both edge strength and orientation
• Mathematically elegant frequency-domain approach
limitations:
• 計算コストが高い due to multiple filter responses
• Sensitive to noise in low-コントラスト regions
• Parameter tuning required for optimal results
• May miss texture-based 異常
• Resolution-dependent performance
